headline: Nearly 19 tons of sausage from Kyrgyzstan detained in Orenburg Region, Russia
summary: Russia's agricultural oversight regulator, Rosselkhoznadzor, detained almost 19 tonnes of sausage imported from Kyrgyzstan in the Orenburg region.
why: Veterinary and phytosanitary inspections by Russia's regulator can halt food shipments, which affects exporters selling into Russia.
original_headline: В Оренбургской области РФ задержали почти 19 тонн колбасы из Кыргызстана
